Subject: NimbleHealth POC — last-week conversion stimulator credit request

Ben —

Quick context: NimbleHealth (POC running on our hosted API) hit a usage inflection over the weekend. They moved from exploratory tests to running full inference pipelines against a 3-model stack and are forecasting sustained consumption next week (~55–70k tokens/day during evaluation windows). Their CSM flagged that procurement wants a final commercial sweetener to push the pilot to a paid commitment before quarter close.

What I’m asking for:
- One-time conversion credit: $15,000 in hosted credits (applied to first invoice).
- Trial extension: +14 days to complete final integration tests.

Rationale:
- NimbleHealth is a strong fit (healthcare workflows + sensitive PHI customers). They asked for a private deployment after POC; likely mid-six-figure ARR if conversion goes well.
- They’re out of runway for the pilot on Friday; procurement asked for an immediate commercial gesture.

Attachments: mutual action plan + updated pricing sheet (included). I’ve sketched a DocuSign path we can send once approved.

Ask: Can you greenlight $15k credit + 14-day extension (or sign off a lower amount if needed)? If approved I’ll route the DocuSign and loop Monica for the onboarding concierge window.

Thanks,
Avery
